reviews.text: BAU is the word: the best place to organize grooming and birthday parties for various pets, even bipeds

My cocker spaniel, Miley, has been at Bauclub daycare since she was a puppy, and I can only say we're lucky to have found this wonderful daycare. The staff is very kind and attentive to each dog's needs. Miley always comes back willingly, in fact, she leaves without even saying goodbye. Since attending Bauclub, she's become more mature, calmer, and even more obedient. We also use Fabio's grooming service and are very happy with it. We highly recommend Bauclub daycare to all dogs.

Bauclub, much more than a doggie daycare.

I had the opportunity to send my Skye to this daycare center for a few years until I moved, and then again last year, once we returned to Milan. It's a large, immaculately clean facility, divided into various areas so our dogs can play but also relax peacefully.

What really makes the difference is the team. All the trainers, without exception, are special; not only are they professional and well-trained, but they truly love dogs; it shows in every look, gesture, and attention. This is also why my Skye was truly happy to attend daycare every day. Taking her to daycare in the morning was a joy, because she couldn't wait to go in. The many videos posted on Instagram showed her calm and active.

Now that my Skye is no longer with us, knowing that she spent so much time truly happy with her canine friends and with the sweet Bauclub team is a knowledge that helps me during this very painful time.
I can only heartily thank all of you at Bauclub for what you have done for Skye ♥️ and recommend this fantastic place to anyone who wants to entrust their dogs, with serenity and tranquility, to competent and loving people.
